—n. Conditional Use Permits

A Conditional Use Permit may be approved by the Town of Bishop Mayor and Council under the procedures in this Section. In addition, the Council, following the procedures in this Section, may also approve changes in the conditions of approval pertaining to a specific Conditional Use Permit.

17 Initiation of Conditional use request.

- a. The owner(s) of a majority interest in the property affected, or their authorized representative, may initiate an application for a Conditional Use Permit for any property or properties in the same manner and pursuant to the same procedures applicable for an application to amend the Official Zoning Map set out in this Article. Such application for a Conditional Use Permit shall be accompanied by a Concept Plan as specified in Section 1704 of these Zoning Regulations.

- b. An application for a Conditional Use Permit affecting the same property shall not be considered by the Bishop Mayor and Council more often than once every 12 months from the date of action by the Mayor and Council either approving or denying the Conditional use; provided, however, that the Mayor and Council may approve a reduction in the waiting period to no less than 6 months. An application for a change to a condition pertaining to the grant of a Conditional Use Permit may be considered at any time.

Ze Compliance with Plans.

If the requested Conditional Use Permit is granted no building permit or other permit or certificate of occupancy shall be granted except for uses or structures conforming substantially with the plans or documents submitted with the application for the Conditional Use.

3s Impact studies.

A traffic study, a hydrology study and other studies of the impact of the proposed development may be Tequired by the Planning Director, Planning Commission or the Mayor and Council as deemed necessary for adequate consideration and a fully-informed decision on the conditional use permit request, relative to the standards for Conditional use consideration contained in Section 1707.5 below.

- 4. Process for Conditional use approval.

Before the Mayor and Council may take final action on a proposed Conditional use, the same process set out for Zoning Amendments in Section 1701 shall be followed. The public hearing is to be conducted in accordance with the provisions of Section 1703.

a, Standards for Conditional use consideration. a. Approval of Conditional use.

A Conditional use otherwise permitted within a zoning district shall be considered to be compatible with other uses permitted in the district, provided that due consideration is given to the following objective criteria. Emphasis may be placed on those criteria most applicable to the specific use proposed:

- 1. Will the proposed Conditional use be consistent with the stated purpose of the zoning district in which it will be located?

- 2. Is the proposed Conditional use compatible with the goals, objectives, purpose and intent of the Comprehensive Plan?

- 3. Will the establishment of the Conditional use impede the normal and orderly development of surrounding property for uses predominate in the

- 5. Is or will the type of street providing access to the use be adequate to serve the proposed Conditional use? ;

- 6. Is or will access into and out of the property be adequate to provide for traffic and pedestrian Safety, the anticipated volume of traffic flow, and access by emergency vehicles?

- 7. Are or will public facilities such as schools, water or sewer utilities, and police or fire protection be adequate to serve the Conditional use?

- 8. Are or will refuse, service, parking and loading areas on the property be located or screened to protect other properties in the area from such adverse effects as noise, light, glare or odor?

- 9. Will the hours and manner of operation of the Conditional use have no adverse effects on other properties in the area?

- 10. Will the current structures by utilized or will the height, size or location of the buildings or other structures on the property be compatible with the height, size or location of buildings or other structures on neighboring properties?

Placing Special Conditions on Conditional Use Permits.

In approving the issuance of any Conditional Use Permit, the Council may impose special conditions which it deems necessary in order to make the requested action consistent with the goals and objectives specified in Section 1707 (5S) (a). Change in conditions of Conditional use approval.

Any application that proposes a change in the conditions of approval previously established by the Mayor and Council through action on a Conditional use shall be reviewed in light of the standards set forth in this Section for a Conditional use, as appropriate.

Withdrawal of Conditional use request.

Any applicant wishing to withdraw a Conditional use application prior to final action by the Mayor and Council shall file a written request for withdrawal with the Planning Director and forwarded to the Mayor and Council.

a.

If the request for withdrawal is received prior to the publication of notice for the public hearing, the application shall be withdrawn administratively by the Planning Director without restriction on the re-filing of a proposed Conditional use on the property in the future.

If notice has been published (or is irretrievably set for publication) but the application has not been heard by the Planning Commission, the application shall be withdrawn administratively by the Planning Director, and an application for
